def count_sort(arr):
  max_num = max(arr)
  count_arr = [0]* (max_num + 1)
  for j in range(len(arr)):
    count_arr[arr[j]] += 1
    temp = count_arr[arr[j]] - 1
    while temp > 0:
      arr[temp + j] = arr[temp + j - 1]
      count_arr[arr[temp + j]] -= 1
      count_arr[arr[temp + j]] += 1
  return arr
